entry.title: Oregon Unemployment Rate Holds At 5.2% In March As Payroll Jobs Decline
entry.summary: Oregon’s unemployment rate stayed at 5.2% in March, but statewide payroll employment fell by 4,800 jobs. Retail trade added jobs, while professional and business services and government saw some of the largest losses.

entry.title: Roseburg Sees Warmest Day Of 2026 So Far
entry.summary: Roseburg hit 85 degrees Sunday, May 3, marking the hottest day of 2026 so far at the Roseburg Regional Airport, according to NOAA data. The day’s average temperature was 11.2 degrees above normal.
